India Secures Multiple Medals in International Olympiads and Commonwealth Games

Indian athletes and students achieved success in international competitions. At the International Chemistry Olympiad, India secured four gold medals and ranked first. The Indian team also won medals at the International Biology Olympiad and Mathematics Olympiads. In the Commonwealth Games, para powerlifter Jhandu clinched a bronze medal, and boxer Lovlina Borgohain assured India of at least one medal by reaching the semifinal. Separately, Neha won a gold medal at the Polyak Imre Ranking Series.
